about: Unminute's install identity, for tests only (#111 B6a and B6b, the owner's decision B6-10). The scripts and the app keep every name as a literal and never read this file; tests/test_consistency.py and tests/powershell keep the copies equal, and pin the names themselves. Changing a name needs the user's say-so (AGENTS.md, K1).
name: Unminute

user.1: failed, including another install still running after 10 minutes
user.2: prerequisites missing, or the install folder is not allowed
user.5: the update waits for the workspace
user.6: this version cannot open the existing workspace, or its location is refused

machine.1: failed, including another install still running after 10 minutes
machine.2: not allowed: a 32-bit or non-elevated run, a refused switch, a package that states no storage format, or prerequisites missing
machine.3: the app is running for someone on this computer
machine.4: the package failed verification, or the install folder's permissions have changed

user.1: failed; with -Offboard also not confirmed, not this account's install, a version too old for the switch or whose files it cannot trust, program files incomplete while data is left, or offboarding stopped at a step, at its 15-minute limit or with a result it cannot read (docs/PACKAGING.md)
user.2: with -Offboard, run as Local System or an account Windows cannot name
user.3: the app, or an install or update, is running
user.5: with -Offboard, offboarding is blocked by meetings, holds, cleanup or audio left
user.6: with -Offboard, the data folder's location is refused

machine.1: failed, including anything in the install folder that the installer did not put there
machine.2: not allowed: a 32-bit or non-elevated run, or -InstallDir or -Offboard with -Machine
machine.3: the app, or an install or update, is running
machine.4: the install folder's permissions have changed
machine.5: a version kept for an earlier storage format is still installed (-IncludeKeptSlots removes it too)
